title: Every coordinate face of a finite simultaneous SNC root algebra is regular
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring such that $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Let $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in A$, $r\geq0$, be equations of the pairwise distinct reduced irreducible branches of a strict normal crossings boundary on $X$, with these branches precisely the closed subschemes $V(t_i)$ [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Let $n\geq1$ be an integer whose image $n\cdot1_A$ is a unit, and put $$C_n=A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]/(x_1^n-t_1,\ldots,x_r^n-t_r),$$ using multivariate polynomial rings [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Then for every subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$ the quotient ring $C_n/(x_j)_{j\in J}$ is a regular Noetherian ring: each of its prime localizations is a regular local ring. Equivalently, the closed subscheme $V(x_j:j\in J)\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}C_n$ is regular. No irreducibility or nonemptiness of the intersections $V(t_j:j\in J)$ is assumed: they may be empty or disconnected, and then the zero ring is allowed. For $J=\varnothing$ this is the regularity of $C_n$ itself; for $r=0$ one has $C_n=A$.

source.place: Expose IX Proposition 2.1 proof, printed p.133, simultaneous parameter-root algebra on a regular SNC pair; the faces $x_j=0$ are the root algebras over the regular strata $V(t_j:j\in J)$.
